summary: Iteration 42: Wallet System - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: Super Admin and Tenant Admin wallet pages fully functional with all tabs, forms, and data display working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Wallet system properly implements multi-tenant SaaS pattern with central payment collection
Super Admin has full control: wallet config, platform revenue, all withdrawals, approve/reject/complete flow
Tenant Admin has limited access: own balance, own withdrawals, request withdrawal
Proper authorization: tenant admin gets 403 on super admin endpoints (config, platform-revenue, all-withdrawals, approve/reject/complete)
Balance calculation correctly accounts for: total revenue, commission (percentage/fixed), withdrawals (approved/completed), pending withdrawals
Withdrawal validation: min amount check, daily limit check, available balance check
Frontend properly renders different views based on user role (super_admin vs tenant_admin)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All wallet features verified for both Super Admin and Tenant Admin)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing withdrawal records
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 42 verified the NEW Wallet System: 1) Backend APIs all working: GET/PUT /api/wallet/config (super admin), GET /api/wallet/platform-revenue (super admin), GET /api/wallet/balance (tenant), GET /api/wallet/balance/{tenant_id} (super admin), POST /api/wallet/withdraw (tenant), GET /api/wallet/withdrawals (tenant), GET /api/wallet/all-withdrawals (super admin), PUT /api/wallet/withdrawals/{id}/approve|reject|complete (super admin). 2) Frontend WalletPage.jsx renders correctly for both roles - Super Admin sees 4 tabs (Platform Revenue, Withdrawal Requests, Tenant Breakdown, Wallet Config), Tenant Admin sees 2 tabs (My Balance, My Withdrawals). 3) Wallet link visible in sidebar for both roles. 4) Withdrawal form has all fields (amount, bank details, UPI, notes). 5) Existing test data: 3 withdrawals (2 completed, 1 rejected) from Anamika tenant.
